title: 52-storey editable multidisciplinary drawing package
scope: Proposed 45-task workflow; neither implemented app capability nor compliance certification. Source references support discipline/framework context; task decomposition and app checks are product-design synthesis.

sources.title: Queensland building laws and codes
sources.scope: Jurisdiction and approval framework; does not establish the applicable edition for an unidentified site.

sources.title: Queensland building approvals and inspections
sources.scope: Approval/inspection framework; exact project pathway requires the certifier and planning authority.

sources.title: BOAQ architectural practice
sources.scope: Architect registration and professional role in Queensland.

sources.title: ABCB using Volume One
sources.scope: Interdependent building performance disciplines; not a source of project-specific numeric rules.

sources.title: WorkSafe Queensland excavation code
sources.scope: Excavation planning, ground conditions and adjacent-structure risks.

sources.title: WorkSafe Queensland safe design of structures
sources.scope: Design risk management through construction, use and maintenance.

sources.title: Queensland Fire Department referral guidelines
sources.scope: Fire-service consultation and referral guidance; determine actual applicability.

sources.title: ABCB Fire Safety Verification Method handbook
sources.scope: Fire-engineering verification process; not automatic approval.

sources.title: ABCB Access Verification Methods handbook
sources.scope: Access verification methodology, requiring applicable design criteria.

sources.title: ABCB energy efficiency provisions tutorial
sources.scope: Building fabric and building-services energy assessment.

sources.title: Queensland BIM implementation principles
sources.scope: Information requirements and coordinated model delivery; not an automatic private-project mandate.

sources.title: buildingSMART Industry Foundation Classes
sources.scope: Open model semantics and version-specific exchange validation.

sources.title: buildingSMART BIM Collaboration Format
sources.scope: Element-linked coordination issues and review history.

sources.title: Brisbane development approvals
sources.scope: Example local-authority pathway only if the site is in Brisbane.

sources.title: Brisbane flood awareness
sources.scope: Example site hazard evidence, not a substitute for a project flood assessment.

tasks.title: Confirm 52-storey benchmark and functional brief
inputs: Site address; intended uses; client brief
outputs: Signed brief; room/area targets; storey-count convention

checks.statement: Requested storeys reconcile with level register; missing uses and areas are flagged
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Client approves scope, occupancy assumptions and budget; do not assume 52 above-ground levels equals regulatory rise in storeys.

tasks.title: Assign discipline responsibility and review gates
inputs: Consultant appointments; competence records
outputs: Responsibility matrix; author/checker/approver assignments

checks.statement: Every package has an accountable owner; approval state is not inferred from a username
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Appoint registered/appropriately qualified professionals for their actual scope; software does not sign for them.

tasks.title: Establish jurisdiction, classification and assessment basis
inputs: Location; uses; development dates; planning instruments
outputs: Applicable-edition register; classifications; approval/referral plan

checks.statement: Every proposed rule has source edition/date/applicability; unknown basis blocks rule-pass claims
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Planner and certifier determine applicable NCC/QDC, local controls, assessment pathway and performance-solution scope.

tasks.title: Establish surveyed site and common datum
inputs: Boundary/cadastral survey; topography; benchmarks
outputs: Survey model; boundary drawing; coordinate/datum statement

checks.statement: Units, north, origin and benchmark transformations agree; survey revision is linked
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Survey professional establishes legal boundary and dependable survey control; aerial imagery is insufficient.

tasks.title: Register site hazards, easements and external constraints
inputs: Planning overlays; easements; flood and environmental reports
outputs: Constraint plan; hazard/consent register

checks.statement: Proposed footprint intersects mapped constraints; every unresolved intersection has an issue
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Specialists assess actual flood, contamination, wind exposure, heritage and environmental obligations as applicable.

tasks.title: Complete ground investigation and design ground model
inputs: Boreholes; testing; groundwater observations; site history
outputs: Geotechnical report; stratigraphy sections; parameter schedule

checks.statement: Every adopted ground parameter links to report location/revision; missing investigation coverage is flagged
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Geotechnical engineer determines investigation sufficiency, groundwater uncertainty and design parameters; no generic soil capacity.

tasks.title: Locate utilities and agree service connection requirements
inputs: Utility owner records; field verification; proposed demands
outputs: Existing/proposed services plan; connection register

checks.statement: Known utilities intersect proposed excavation; each assumed location is marked unverified
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Utility owners and engineers confirm capacity, protection, easements and connection conditions.

tasks.title: Define editable information and drawing delivery contract
inputs: Client information requirements; exchange recipients
outputs: Model authoring rules; naming; sheet index; revision/issue schema

checks.statement: Unique IDs, units, layer/type names and expected deliverables validate against the agreed contract
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Agree authoring responsibility, detail level, exchange versions and intellectual-property permissions.

tasks.title: Create grids, level register and tower zoning
inputs: Brief; survey; constraints
outputs: Editable grids/levels; basement/podium/tower/roof zoning diagrams

checks.statement: No duplicate level IDs; elevations monotonic where required; floor-to-floor and total-height sums reconcile
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect coordinates usable floor zones; structural/services leads accept initial spatial reservations.

tasks.title: Establish fire and evacuation design strategy
inputs: Occupancy model; classifications; core alternatives
outputs: Fire strategy; compartment/egress concept; referral issues

checks.statement: Every floor has modeled exit destinations; strategy assumptions link to affected levels
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Fire engineer and certifier establish strategy, performance evidence and referral needs; geometric connectivity alone is not safe egress.

tasks.title: Select gravity and lateral structural concept
inputs: Ground model; architectural masses; design actions basis
outputs: Structural concept; load-path diagrams; analysis brief

checks.statement: Member/support connectivity and model units are consistent; unidentified loads remain unresolved
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Structural engineer selects systems and establishes load cases, stability, movement and analysis requirements.

tasks.title: Reserve plant, shafts and distribution zones
inputs: Occupancy/demand assumptions; service strategy; lift brief
outputs: Services zoning; riser/plant reservations; preliminary lift schedule

checks.statement: Reserved zones exist on every affected level and do not silently overlap structure/egress
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Discipline engineers establish demand, redundancy, pressure zones, plant strategy and lift traffic criteria.

tasks.title: Design excavation, retention and adjacent protection
inputs: Basement extent; ground/water data; neighbouring assets
outputs: Excavation sections; retention drawings; monitoring and dewatering strategy

checks.statement: Excavation envelopes clash with utilities or boundaries; monitoring points link to affected assets
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Competent engineers establish temporary stability, groundwater effects, movement criteria and construction sequence.

tasks.title: Develop foundations and ground-bearing elements
inputs: Support reactions; approved ground model; retention scheme
outputs: Foundation setting-out; pile/raft/footing drawings and schedules

checks.statement: Foundation/support IDs match reactions and grids; geometry and quantities reconcile
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Engineers determine bearing, piles/raft, settlement, uplift and detailing; app does not size foundations from storey count.

tasks.title: Draft basement layouts and access
inputs: Basement brief; ramps; service rooms; core reservations
outputs: Basement plans/sections; parking and circulation layouts

checks.statement: Ramp geometry, clear headroom and route connectivity compare with approved project criteria
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect and relevant specialists resolve parking, accessibility, fire and operational requirements.

tasks.title: Detail basement walls, slabs and retaining interfaces
inputs: Foundation design; basement layouts; water pressures
outputs: Basement structural plans; wall/slab sections; joint details

checks.statement: Slab/wall openings and construction joints align across models; member references are complete
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Engineer verifies strength, serviceability, water-retaining behavior and staged construction.

tasks.title: Coordinate basement services, drainage and smoke systems
inputs: Plant reservations; basement use; fire strategy
outputs: Basement service plans; drainage/sump and ventilation schematics

checks.statement: Drainage paths have approved falls; service routes and access volumes are not obstructed
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Engineers establish drainage, ventilation, smoke-control and fire-service design parameters.

tasks.title: Develop ground plane and podium public interfaces
inputs: Street/survey levels; podium uses; access strategy
outputs: Ground/podium plans; public-interface sections; landscape/civil interfaces

checks.statement: Accessible route geometry and level transitions match approved criteria; entries connect to intended destinations
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect/civil/landscape specialists resolve public access, flood interfaces, streetscape and planning conditions.

tasks.title: Resolve podium and transfer structure
inputs: Tower column/core positions; podium spans; reactions
outputs: Transfer plans/sections; structural schedules; analysis references

checks.statement: Upper supports map to receiving structure; discontinuities and openings are explicitly recorded
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Structural engineer verifies transfer actions, deflection, punching/shear and temporary loading where relevant.

tasks.title: Develop continuous core, stairs and protected routes
inputs: Level register; fire strategy; core structure
outputs: Core plans on each level; stair sections; core wall/opening schedules

checks.statement: Stair flights/landings connect; headroom/width measured against approved criteria; core openings match structure
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect, structural and fire leads approve core layout and performance assumptions.

tasks.title: Engineer lifts and vertical-transport interfaces
inputs: Traffic study; supplier data; operational/fire strategies
outputs: Lift layouts; shaft/pit/overrun sections; interfaces and equipment schedule

checks.statement: Supplier envelope, pit, overhead and maintenance volumes fit each designated shaft
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Lift specialist and suppliers establish capacity, travel, zoning, emergency use and certification interfaces.

tasks.title: Author editable typical floor families
inputs: Accommodation brief; structure/service zones; unit/workplace types
outputs: Editable typical plans; room boundaries; type catalogue; plans by level

checks.statement: Areas close; rooms/doors/windows retain IDs; repeat instances link to explicit type revisions
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect approves functional layout, amenity and spatial quality; generated repetition is a draft.

tasks.title: Develop tower framing and floor structure
inputs: Architectural floors; analysis actions; structural concept
outputs: Column/core/slab plans by zone; member and reinforcement references

checks.statement: Geometry/connectivity and section schedules match model; floor openings have accountable references
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Engineer performs/verifies structural analysis and detailing, including movement and construction effects.

tasks.title: Resolve non-typical, refuge, transfer and plant floors where applicable
inputs: Explicit exceptional-level list; functional/engineering requirements
outputs: Distinct exceptional floor plans and coordinated sections

checks.statement: Every level uses a declared type or explicit exception; no exceptional floor is copied silently
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Relevant professionals determine whether refuge or other special facilities apply; their existence is not assumed from 52 storeys.

tasks.title: Develop continuous risers and penetrations register
inputs: Service demands; floor geometry; fire compartment strategy
outputs: Riser diagrams; coordinated shaft plans; penetration schedule

checks.statement: Risers connect designated levels; every penetration references host element, service and required treatment
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: MEP/structural/fire leads agree opening sizes, support, access and fire-stopping design.

tasks.title: Develop HVAC, ventilation and smoke-control drawings
inputs: Loads; system strategy; plant data; fire interfaces
outputs: Mechanical plans; duct/plant schedules; control and smoke schematics

checks.statement: Duct networks connect intended terminals; specified access/clearance and section reservations are measurable
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Mechanical/fire specialists validate loads, airflows, pressure relationships, acoustics and operating modes.

tasks.title: Develop water, sanitary and stormwater systems
inputs: Demand and supply data; drainage strategy; roof catchments assumptions
outputs: Hydraulic plans; pressure-zone/riser diagrams; drainage schedules

checks.statement: Connectivity, inverts and declared gradients reconcile; unresolved catchments remain flagged
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Engineers determine sizing, pressure, backflow, storage, discharge and authority requirements.

tasks.title: Develop power, communications and emergency interfaces
inputs: Demand calculations; utility conditions; equipment and fire strategy
outputs: Single-line diagrams; electrical/communications plans; load schedules

checks.statement: Circuit/equipment IDs and space reservations reconcile; missing supply paths are flagged
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Engineers validate protection, capacity, reliability, emergency systems and specialist interfaces.

tasks.title: Coordinate fire detection, suppression and brigade facilities
inputs: Approved fire strategy; hydraulic/electrical interfaces; referral advice
outputs: Fire-service plans; schematics; cause/effect matrix; equipment schedule

checks.statement: Required equipment and interfaces from the approved strategy are present; routes/access volumes are checked
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Fire-service engineers and relevant authority determine hydraulic/electrical performance and brigade intervention provisions.

tasks.title: Author facade modules, openings and elevation system
inputs: Architectural intent; grids/levels; material strategy
outputs: Editable elevations; facade module types; opening and interface schedules

checks.statement: Facade closes intended boundaries; openings and panels match plan/section IDs; duplicate surfaces are flagged
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect/facade specialist reviews expression, material suitability and interfaces.

tasks.title: Verify facade performance and attachment design
inputs: Movement/load criteria; product evidence; fire strategy
outputs: Facade details; anchors; movement joints; test/evidence schedule

checks.statement: Anchor/support references exist; movement/access zones fit; specified products link to evidence
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Qualified specialists assess wind, water, structural attachment, fire behavior and movement; closed mesh is not weatherproofing proof.

tasks.title: Develop roof, plant enclosure and drainage geometry
inputs: Roof uses; plant; drainage criteria; envelope details
outputs: Roof plans; falls; sections; outlets/overflow and parapet details

checks.statement: Catchment topology and falls route to intended outlets; roof edges meet intended facade boundaries
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect and engineers approve drainage capacity, waterproofing, structural support and overflow strategy.

tasks.title: Coordinate maintenance, replacement and roof access
inputs: Equipment replacement envelopes; access and maintenance strategy
outputs: Maintenance-access plans; lifting/replacement routes; facade access interfaces

checks.statement: Equipment can geometrically traverse declared replacement routes; designated service zones remain clear
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Designers, operators and specialists assess safe access, lifting, fall risks and maintenance method.

tasks.title: Develop doors, windows, partitions and interior details
inputs: Room/type data; fire/acoustic/access requirements
outputs: Door/window/finish schedules; partition types; key details

checks.statement: Schedule tags resolve to objects; swings/clear openings and host geometry agree
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Architect and specialists approve hardware, fire/acoustic ratings, finishes and suitability.

tasks.title: Coordinate wet areas, acoustic separation and envelope interfaces
inputs: Use-specific performance targets; product/system evidence
outputs: Wet-area details; acoustic junctions; waterproofing interface register

checks.statement: Detail references cover designated wet/acoustic interfaces; missing continuity is flagged
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Specialists validate acoustic and moisture performance and constructibility; geometric continuity is only a screening check.

tasks.title: Complete energy and environmental performance assessment
inputs: Applicable assessment basis; fabric and equipment data
outputs: Energy model/report; specification values; evidence links

checks.statement: Assessment inputs match current design revision and schedules; absent values block a verified result
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Qualified assessors determine method, assumptions and performance against applicable requirements.

tasks.title: Review whole-building accessible routes and facilities
inputs: Approved access criteria; site-to-destination route model
outputs: Access review plan; issue list; facility/detail schedule

checks.statement: Measure routes, thresholds, turning/approach areas and openings against supplied criteria
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Access specialist and certifier determine applicability, equivalent outcomes and usability; app reports measured evidence and uncertainty.

tasks.title: Run model federation and clash review
inputs: Current discipline models; approved clash tolerances
outputs: Federated model; element-linked clash/clearance issues

checks.statement: Hard intersections, clearance envelopes, duplicate geometry and disconnected paths reported with coordinates and IDs
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Owners classify intentional intersections and resolve design conflicts; zero reported clashes is not design approval.

tasks.title: Complete structural design verification and independent review as required
inputs: Analysis models/results; current drawings; reviewer scope
outputs: Checked structural package; calculation register; resolved review comments

checks.statement: Drawing/calculation/member revisions correspond; required review records exist
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Responsible engineers verify strength, stability, serviceability, ground interaction and necessary independent review.

tasks.title: Complete fire strategy evidence and referral resolution
inputs: Fire report; coordinated drawings; stakeholder comments
outputs: Fire evidence package; referral responses; resolved strategy issues

checks.statement: Fire strategy commitments map to current drawings/equipment; unresolved departures block issue readiness
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Fire engineer, certifier and applicable referral bodies review evidence and formal decisions.

tasks.title: Review construction sequence and safe-design residual risks
inputs: Construction methodology; temporary works; plant/access constraints
outputs: Sequence diagrams; temporary/permanent interface plans; residual-risk register

checks.statement: Sequence references existing elements; temporary supports are not omitted from dependencies
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Contractor and responsible designers/engineers review erection, excavation, lifting and temporary stability; app does not prescribe a safe method.

tasks.title: Reconcile drawing schedules and source-linked quantities
inputs: Current model objects; measurement rules; drawing index
outputs: Sheet/schedule registers; transparent measured quantities; exclusions

checks.statement: IDs and revision counts agree; quantities recompute from named rules; unknown quantities are not zero
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Quantity surveyor reviews scope/measurement conventions; estimates and procurement prices remain separate approved processes.

tasks.title: Assemble and review coordinated drawing package
inputs: Checked discipline packages; decisions; issue purpose
outputs: Editable authoring package; view/sheet set; PDF issue; model exchange; signed review register

checks.statement: All sheet references resolve; revision/scale/title/level metadata valid; missing approvals and stale inputs block issue-ready status
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Actual professionals approve their scope and certifier determines approval status. App-generated issue-ready is not statutory approval or a professional signature.

tasks.title: Revise, compare and reissue without losing prior decisions
inputs: Change request; previous frozen issue; affected object graph
outputs: Revision diff; affected sheets; superseded issue archive; new review tasks

checks.statement: Changed objects invalidate dependent checks/approvals; old issue hashes remain immutable; exports round-trip declared fields
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Discipline owners re-review impacted design; delivery and recipient acknowledgement require explicit evidence.

tasks.title: Record commissioning, as-built changes and handover evidence
inputs: Inspection/test results; approved changes; operations requirements
outputs: As-built package; commissioning register; O&M and asset records

checks.statement: Installed IDs/results link to assets and revision; missing certificates/tests remain open
checks.basis: User-approved project criteria and current source-bound model; no embedded code thresholds

professionalReview.judgment: Inspectors, certifier, specialist contractors and operators determine acceptance, occupation and operating requirements; planned documents do not prove installed performance.
